notes.title: Removing a few Rotten Eggs in v1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with Steam Cloud not working with game savedata.
- Fixed issue with Steam saying macOS 10.15+ was unsupported.
- Fixed leaderboards not grabbing the WR ghost when the WR is changing.
- Fixed issues some players had with final level not posting leaderboard times, now need to beat 3 minute timer.
- Fixed an issue with players unlocking levels without beating them.
- Fixed a confusion about track 2 checkpoints.
- Fixed a tree growing up through a towel on the beach.

Join the community on [b]March 30th[/b] and compete for fame and glory!
